tasks.task: Audit a CRM export and write the fix list

items.when: When the team does not trust the CRM and you need each problem counted and a change list written
When you want a second pass over deals for missing fields, stale dates and stage mismatches
When the export is large and you need gaps, duplicates and odd values found with rules to catch them
When the owner wants one score to track month by month as the data gets cleaner
When marketing cannot tie leads to campaigns and you suspect the source fields

tasks.task: Run the weekly pipeline review with deals at risk

items.when: Every week before the sales meeting, to turn the export into what changed and what to act on
When you need stage conversion, time in stage and at-risk deals from this week's export
When the review should run the same way each week and end in a fix list to approve
When the manager wants the view by rep and stage with coaching points
When you need a short alert list of quiet deals, slipping close dates and renewals
When one flagged deal has gone quiet and the rep needs the likely reason and a message to send

tasks.task: Build a sales forecast with best, likely and worst cases

items.when: When the owner asks what will close this quarter and needs a range, not one number
When you want a second forecast built as commit, best case and upside to compare
When the forecast is drafted, to test pipeline cover against quota and past forecast accuracy
Before the forecast workbook is shared, to catch broken formulas and totals that do not tie
When a range must be explained to people who want a single figure

tasks.task: Find where deals drop out and which number moved

items.when: When sales fell and you must say whether volume, win rate, deal size or cycle length changed
When you need cover, ageing and conversion stage by stage to find the weak one
When you have stage-change history and want conversion and time between each step
When deals wait on an internal step, such as legal or pricing sign-off, to map who holds them up
When a pattern looks real and you want it tested before it goes in the report

tasks.task: Design or repair pipeline stages with entry and exit rules

items.when: When stages mean different things to different reps or deals sit in the wrong stage
Before redesigning, to see which current stages deals skip, stall in or fall out of
When you want a second stage and handoff model to compare with your own
When win rate or stage conversion needs one written definition everyone reports from

tasks.task: Define lifecycle stages and the lead handoff rules

items.when: When marketing and sales disagree on what a lead is and when it passes across
When you need scoring, stages and the handoff from marketing to sales in one written model
When new leads sit unassigned and you need routing rules and a handoff note per lead
When the handoff rule rewards lead volume and nobody checks whether those leads become customers

tasks.task: Build lead scoring rules from past leads

items.when: When sales says the leads are poor and you have a year of leads with their outcomes
When the rules are agreed and the current list needs scoring into ranked tiers
When you want a simpler grade to compare with the points model before choosing
When you must test whether a trait really separates won leads from lost ones

tasks.task: Review why deals are won and lost

items.when: When you have a quarter of closed deals with notes and want reasons and playbook changes
When you need loss stage, common objections and deal traits counted across closed deals
When the question is why you really win, to find it and the message built on it
When lost deals should be reviewed every month, with objection answers to add
When CRM loss reasons are thin and you need a script for asking recent buyers what happened
Before the report goes out, so each finding points to the deals and notes behind it

tasks.task: Report on cancellation reasons and churn

items.when: When you have cancellations with notes and want the stated and real reasons grouped
When churn should be watched each month from the billing export
When you need to see which sign-up months keep customers and which lose them early
When the owner wants live accounts scored for risk, not only a look back
When the reasons are known and each needs a save offer or a fix

tasks.task: Write an automation workflow spec a builder can follow

items.when: When the team wants lead routing, reminders or a closed-won handoff built and needs the spec
Before specifying, to decide if the step should be automated at all and what the fallback is
When you want a quick second layout of the steps for Zapier or Make, with what can break
When the build will be no-code and you need the right setup and when to move to code
Before go-live, to find double runs, missing approvals and silent failures, with a test list
When the CRM's own workflows cannot reach the other app in the chain

tasks.task: Audit existing automations and nurture flows

items.when: When an old workflow must be rewritten so its trigger, steps and exit are on paper
When you review each live workflow for double sends, loops and steps with no owner
When the nurture flow only pushes for a meeting and needs useful content first
When deciding which of dozens of old workflows to keep, merge or switch off

tasks.task: Set up or rebuild a CRM around how the team sells

items.when: When a team moves from spreadsheets, switches CRM or rebuilds one nobody opens
When the CRM is not yet chosen, to compare options on criteria, cost and a trial plan
When data moves from the old tool and you need field maps, checks and a way back
When reps resisted the last tool and the launch needs messages and a plan for pushback
Before go-live, to list launch checks, open blockers and who decided what

tasks.task: Clean a messy list and prepare the import sheet

items.when: When a contact export must be deduplicated and tidied with every change listed
When the file is messy and must be fixed and re-checked until it passes your rules
When each old column needs mapping to a CRM field before the import
After the clean-up, to prove blanks and duplicates are gone before anyone imports

tasks.task: Split territories and set quotas with the maths shown

items.when: At annual planning, a new hire or when reps doubt their number, from account and sales history
When there are two fair ways to cut the map, to put both on a page with the numbers and pick one
When the quota total needs more reps and you must say which roles to hire in what order
Before reps see the quota workbook, to find formula errors and broken links

tasks.task: Check the sales pay plan and discount rules

items.when: When you suspect the commission plan pays for deals that churn, to see what it rewards
When hiring reps, to get a scorecard, a pay plan check and one early sign of customer success
When discounts are given ad hoc and you need a matrix with approval limits
When one deal carries a big discount or changed terms and needs a margin and risk verdict

tasks.task: Write a dashboard build sheet with every measure defined

items.when: When each role needs its own view and you must pick the measures by the decisions they make
When each measure needs its formula, filters and source written once
When two reports show different numbers for the same measure
When a number jumped and you suspect its definition changed, not the business
When a measure must be pulled from a database and nobody on the team writes SQL
Before a query feeds a dashboard, to catch joins that double count

tasks.task: Reconcile CRM deals against billing records

items.when: When closed-won deals, subscriptions and invoices disagree and you need each mismatch listed
When mismatches come from how the systems sync and you need the webhook and matching checks
When the reconciliation is a workbook, to check the lookups and tie-out totals
When the match is done with a query, to catch rows dropped or counted twice

tasks.task: Run the monthly billing and churn close

items.when: In the first working days of the month, before finance closes or the board update goes out
When recurring revenue in the CRM and in billing must agree before anyone reports it
When recurring revenue, churn and payback need reading with what to fix first
When the owner asks what a customer is worth against what it costs to win one
When the close must become a short update for the owner or the board
Before the update goes out, to drill the numbers a board member will push on

tasks.task: Sort and check the refund and billing change queue

items.when: When refund, credit, plan change and dispute requests pile up and each needs sorting and checking
When a decision is made and the customer needs a clear yes, partial or no
When many requests are cancellations and a save offer or failed-payment plan would cut them

tasks.task: Agree how marketing and sales credit revenue

items.when: When two teams report different revenue for the same campaign and need one model
When you have campaign data and need credit by channel and where leads drop off
Before trusting any attribution report, to check the source fields can carry it

tasks.task: Track renewals and accounts at risk

items.when: When you need upcoming renewals listed with timing, risk and room to raise the price
When renewals should be ranked by health so the team calls the shaky ones first
When renewal reminders should fire on their own and the builder needs the spec

always.when: Before any workbook leaves, to find wrong totals and say the key figures in plain words
Whenever a report quotes a rate or a total, so its formula and source are written down

helpers.when: When the spec is agreed and someone must build and test the automation
When dashboards need building in a BI tool with a proper data model
When the clean-up needs standing rules, owners and monitoring, not one pass
When the forecast must tie to the budget, cash plan or board pack
When win-loss findings must become playbook changes, battlecards and coaching
When nurture and renewal emails need writing, not only the trigger logic

gaps: No library item splits territories from an account list or checks the split for balance
No library item sets quotas from sales history and rep capacity, or builds the quota workbook
No library item derives lead scoring points from past leads and back-tests the threshold
No library item reconciles CRM closed-won deals against subscriptions and invoices in a billing tool
No library item builds the monthly recurring revenue movement: new, expansion, contraction and churn
No library item writes a CRM field and naming plan with required fields and picklist values
No library item finds and merges duplicate contacts and companies in HubSpot or Salesforce exports
No library item audits a HubSpot or Salesforce account's live workflows for overlap and conflicts
No library item specifies CRM views and dashboards by role inside the CRM itself
No library item triages a queue of refund, credit and plan change requests
No library item tracks forecast accuracy quarter by quarter or reviews quota attainment
